item.title: This conversation isn’t about iced coffee
item.description:
This conversation isn’t about iced coffee. I’m sure for some people it is, but just as she abstracts to general principles of professionalism we should take a critical eye to those general principles - and the way that things like this hide the bigotry’s built into those principles, and how even that manner of browbeating serves them by obscuring systems of power for morality
